faqs.question: What Mercedes-Benz cars do you have in stock?
faqs.answer: We hold over 30 quality used Mercedes-Benz cars at our Northfields, Ealing showroom at any one time. Our full inventory is listed on our stock page and updated regularly, so you can check availability before you visit.

faqs.question: Do you offer car finance?
faqs.answer: Yes. IQ Motors offers flexible finance options on our used Mercedes-Benz stock, including part exchange. Call us on 07877 028198 to discuss a package that suits your budget.

faqs.question: Do you deliver cars?
faqs.answer: Yes — we offer free delivery within 10 miles of our Ealing showroom. A charge applies for delivery beyond 10 miles and fast delivery is available. Call 07877 028198 to arrange.

faqs.question: When are you open?
faqs.answer: We are open 7 days a week on an appointment-only basis, with same-day appointments often available. Message us outside office hours and we will be happy to help.

faqs.question: Will servicing at IQ Motors affect my Mercedes-Benz warranty?
faqs.answer: No. All servicing is carried out in accordance with Manufacturer Service Schedules, which means your new car warranty will be unaffected.

faqs.question: Can you beat Mercedes main dealer service prices?
faqs.answer: Yes. We guarantee to beat any local Mercedes main dealer price for an identical service.
